summary: Verified mobile (390x844) accordion clipping fix in CoachSection. All three accordion items ('Formación', 'Filosofía de Entrenamiento', 'Tus coaches funcionales') expand completely without clipping. For 'Tus coaches funcionales': panel height 614px vs inner content 182px (measurement shows inner well within max-h-[1500px] container), all 6 '¿Quieres...' items visible, and final italic 'Cada plan, cada sesión, cada detalle está pensado para que avances.' fully rendered and visible. Bug is fixed.
critical_code_review_comments: max-h-[1500px] is a magic number; if content grows further it could clip again. Consider a more robust approach using grid-template-rows 0fr->1fr transition or JS-measured scrollHeight for future-proofing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static React site, Spanish, no backend. Only accordion clipping bug in CoachSection was in scope and is verified fixed on mobile 390x844.
